name: A. Sam Dibaei
office: City of Malibu, Member of the City Council

items.text: A. Sam Dibaei says he is a general counsel and trial attorney. He lists fire, water and safety as his top priorities. At a candidate forum, he said the city should take proactive measures to prevent fires and floods, and he suggested using radio for emergency notices. The State Bar of California disbarred him in 2022 for moral turpitude, finding he took money from clients and coerced them.
